fields.title: procurement.gov.ki Kiribati tender record
fields.description: One record per row in the Central Procurement Unit's chronological tender list (both open and long-closed tenders, newest first). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a request fails or is unreachable.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record, or 'none' on error.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on a failed run (blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

referenceNumber.title: Reference number
referenceNumber.description: The Central Procurement Unit's own procurement number for this tender.

procuringEntity.title: Procuring entity
procuringEntity.description: The government ministry/agency acronym running this procurement (e.g. MOE, MFED, MCIA).

openDate.title: Open date
openDate.description: Upstream free-text date the tender opened.

detailUrl.title: Detail page URL
detailUrl.description: The tender's own procurement.gov.ki page, which carries downloadable tender documents not repeated here.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns -- rows missing a given column render blank.
